title: Android Backup Coverage
user: Android owners who self-host or use multiple backup destinations and need proof that new photos and selected folders actually reached a second copy.
smallest_useful_product: An Android app that inventories configured source folders, computes local file manifests, reads a user-selected destination manifest/share, highlights missing/late files, and schedules a visible verification reminder.
success_measure: In a 60-day pilot, 95% of newly captured photos are marked verified within the user’s chosen window and every simulated missing upload is surfaced within 24 hours.
constraints: Respect Android scoped-storage permissions and battery limits; do not claim to back up app-private data; manifests must be encrypted or local; make destination adapters opt-in.
